extension.title: Browser extension
extension.steps:
1. Click Open folder: the extension's folder opens.
2. In Chrome, Edge, Brave or Opera, open the extensions page ({address}) and turn on Developer mode.
3. Click Load unpacked and choose that folder.
4. On a video page, click Orbida's button in the toolbar (or press Alt+Shift+D), or right-click a link and choose Download link with Orbida. The first time, allow the browser to open Orbida.
extension.firefox: Firefox: click Add to Firefox, then Add. The add-on is signed by Mozilla and stays after Firefox closes.
extension.firefox_opened: Firefox asks whether to add Orbida: click Add.
extension.firefox_file: Firefox was not found: drag Orbida.xpi from the folder that opened into a Firefox window.
extension.firefox_missing: This copy has no Firefox add-on: download the .xpi file from the release page.
extension.copied: Address copied: paste it into the browser's address bar.
extension.description: Send the video you are watching, or any link, to the Orbida app.
